SELECT
  t.id,
  t.title,
  t.status,
  t.assignee_id,
  t.project_id,
  t.due_date,
  t.story_points,
  t.updated_at,
  t.is_bottleneck,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - t.updated_at)) / 3600, 2) AS hours_since_update,
  m.full_name  AS assignee_name,
  m.email      AS assignee_email,
  m.telegram_id AS assignee_telegram,
  p.name       AS project_name,
  p.deadline   AS project_deadline
FROM tasks t
LEFT JOIN members  m ON t.assignee_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN projects p ON t.project_id  = p.id
WHERE t.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'IN_REVIEW')
  AND t.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $json.stuck_threshold_hours }} hours'
ORDER BY t.updated_at ASC;

UPDATE tasks
SET
  is_bottleneck = true,
  updated_at    = NOW()
WHERE status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'IN_REVIEW')
  AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $('Code - Set Alert Config').first().json.stuck_threshold_hours }} hours'
  AND is_bottleneck = false
RETURNING id, title, status, is_bottleneck, updated_at;

INSERT INTO task_logs (task_id, changed_by, old_status, new_status, comment)
SELECT
  id,
  NULL,
  status,
  status,
  'STUCK ALERT (Flow 6): Task bi ket ' ||
    ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - updated_at)) / 3600)::INT ||
    ' gio. Auto-detected by n8n Cron Flow 6.'
FROM tasks
WHERE status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'IN_REVIEW')
  AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $('Code - Set Alert Config').first().json.stuck_threshold_hours }} hours'
RETURNING id, task_id, new_status, comment, logged_at;

INSERT INTO activity_history
  (task_id, member_id, action_type, old_value, new_value, metadata)
SELECT
  t.id,
  t.assignee_id,
  'STUCK_DETECTED',
  t.status,
  'BLOCKED',
  '{"source": "n8n_flow6_cron", "alert_type": "stuck_task_auto_detect"}'
FROM tasks t
WHERE t.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'IN_REVIEW')
  AND t.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '{{ $('Code - Set Alert Config').first().json.stuck_threshold_hours }} hours'
RETURNING id, task_id, action_type, created_at;

INSERT INTO reports
  (project_id, report_type, risk_score, ai_summary, metrics)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.first_project_id }}',
  'STUCK_TASK_ALERT',
  {{ $json.risk_score }},
  '{{ $json.alert_level + ": " + $json.alert_message }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metrics) }}'
)
RETURNING *;
